_about: Anatomical centring landmarks for the x-ray protocols, measured by tools/measure_landmarks.py. Volume-frame entries are cm from the volume centre (x, y, z; +z superior) and are mapped to the world through the same flips and rotation as the phantom. Entries marked frame:"world" are already in the x-ray world frame. Re-run the tool after rebuilding a model.

knee.how: joint-space valley between the condyles and the plateau (prominence 14.1 cm2)

ankle.how: the tibiotalar joint: the first joint sheet down the tibia's axis (the subtalar is the next)

hip.how: peak of the proximal bulge: femoral head and trochanters

femur.how: midway between the knee and hip landmarks

foot.how: tarsals, 3 cm above the inferior end (the sole of the foot at 90 degrees)

elbow.how: widest bone in the 8 cm below the humeral shaft (which ends at 37.6 cm): the epicondyles

forearm.how: midway between the radiocarpal joint and the epicondyles

wrist.how: 1.5 cm past the radiocarpal joint (the thinnest bone 18-28 cm below the elbow, at 14.6 cm): the carpals

shoulder.how: biggest bone section in the 12 cm above the humeral shaft: the humeral head

humerus.how: midway between the elbow and shoulder landmarks

wrist.how: 2 cm proximal of the first slice that cuts all five metacarpals: the carpals

hand.how: distal end of the five-metacarpal zone: the MCP joints, the PA hand centring point

fingers.how: midway from the MCP joints to the fingertips: PIP level

skull.how: bone-weighted centre of the upper half (the cranium)

cspine.how: C4 vertebral body, from the vertebra labels of the CT (s1082), registered to the model (99.9% of label voxels on bone)

skull.how: the centre of the cranial cavity (the brain and CSF of the model)

kub.how: iliac crest (= L4/L5), from the DXA landmark finder

abdomenErect.how: 5 cm above the crest, to include the diaphragm

pelvis.how: midway between the ASIS (-20.0 / -15.8, mean -17.9) and the pubic symphysis (-29.4)

lumbar.how: L3: crest (L4/L5) + 1.5 x the measured 3.6 cm lumbar period; AP depth = centre of the vertebral body

thoracic.how: T7: L1 + six thoracic bodies at ~2.6 cm (estimated, not measured); AP depth = centre of the vertebral body

femoralHeadL.how: centre of the 2.2 cm sphere through the most cortical bone (head and acetabular shells)

femoralHeadR.how: centre of the 2.2 cm sphere through the most cortical bone (head and acetabular shells)

thoracic.how: T7: the vertebral body (anterior 40 % of its label), from the pediatric model's own labels (build_pediatric.py)

lumbar.how: L3: the vertebral body, from the pediatric model's own labels (build_pediatric.py)

kub.how: the level of the iliac crests (the tops of the hip-bone labels, 12.1 / 12.5), = L4-L5, on the midline at the depth of L4

abdomenErect.how: 4 cm above the crest (a child's 5): the diaphragm in the field

pelvis.how: midway between the ASIS (5.3 / 5.6) and the pubic symphysis (-2.8)

skull.how: bone-weighted centre of the upper half of the skull label (the cranium)

cspine.how: C4: the vertebral body, from the pediatric model's own labels (build_pediatric.py) (the head donor's ground truth)

kneeR.how: the knee joint space, the lower extremity's measured landmark carried through the leg's graft

ankleR.how: the tibiotalar joint, the lower extremity's measured landmark carried through the leg's graft

kneeL.how: the knee joint space, the lower extremity's measured landmark carried through the leg's graft

ankleL.how: the tibiotalar joint, the lower extremity's measured landmark carried through the leg's graft

elbowR.how: the centre of the arm's bone at the elbow joint (z053, build_limbs.ARMS), carried through the arm's graft

wristR.how: the centre of the carpus (z053, 1.2 cm below the radiocarpal joint), carried through the arm's graft

elbowL.how: the centre of the arm's bone at the elbow joint (z053, build_limbs.ARMS), carried through the arm's graft

wristL.how: the centre of the carpus (z053, 1.2 cm below the radiocarpal joint), carried through the arm's graft
